emma_cs: Customer kickoff tomorrow — they want a one-page "Rapid Onboard" playbook (ops-friendly) covering prefill, batching, KV caching, streaming, quick checks, and 72h renewal risk signals. Can we draft?

raj_se: I'll write a tight, copy-pasteable one-pager. Keep knobs only from hosted + dedicated.

morgan_sre: Add a 3-step degraded flow they can run without us. Also include simple metric checks.

kai_support: I'll add the top 5 FAQs we've seen. Keep answers 1-2 lines.

olivia_pm: Include two rules for renewal risk: token/day > +40% baseline for 24h, or P95 > SLO for 2+ hours.

raj_se: Draft (short):
"Rapid Onboard — Ops Playbook"
- Preflight: run a 10-min prefill for ~15% active users to seed KV cache. Capture baseline tokens/day.
- Prefill snippet (copy/paste):
  for i in $(seq 1 150); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"welcome\",\"max_tokens\":64,\"metadata\":{\"prefill\":true}}' & done; wait
- Batching: short prompts (<80 tokens) -> target_batch_size=24, max_wait_ms=25. Long outputs -> reduce batch size to 4-8.
- KV cache: enable prefix cache; prefix_ttl=300s for interactive, 30-60s for high-churn.
- Streaming: enable for long human-facing output (>512 tokens); set keepalive_s=12 and socket_timeout_ms=45000.
- Cost guard: set daily_token_limit + alert @60-75% and per-minute caps for pilots.
- Metrics to check (first 72h): P95 latency, tokens/day delta vs baseline, 4xx/5xx rate.
- Quick degraded flow (30+ min tail pain): 1) Route to alternate region; 2) Decrease max_tokens by 25% and halve batch size; 3) Enable compact fallback model; 4) Open cs ticket with sample requests.
- What to include for support: sample request JSON, route.name, account_id, prompt_hash, timestamp.

morgan_sre: Mini validation commands:
- Check cache hit: curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" https://api.redwood.com/v1/metrics?name=prefix_cache_hit_rate
- Confirm warm vs cold: run 30 warm requests vs 30 cold and compare median latency.

kai_support: Top-5 FAQs (one-line answers):
1) Tokens jumped after integration? -> Likely verbose per-request system prompts or no client dedupe; enable dedupe + prefill.
2) How to avoid cold starts? -> Prefill 10-15% of users and use warm pools.
3) Streaming stalls on mobile? -> Increase keepalive and check proxies for buffering.
4) How to limit unexpected spend? -> Use daily_token_limit + per-minute caps and alerts.
5) Latency varies a lot? -> Check batch sizing and cache hit rates.

olivia_pm: Add escalation: if two renewal-risk signals fire in 72h, label ticket cs:rapid-review and CS+Eng will run a config audit and may apply temporary protections.

doc_bot: doc_bot: Draft saved to /portal-drafts/cs/rapid-onboard-playbook-v1 (preview internal link).

emma_cs: Great. I'll convert to PDF/HTML and attach to kickoff email. Owner: emma_cs. Due: tomorrow 9am PT.

raj_se: Small note: include telemetry headers to send: X-Request-ID, service.customer_id, route.name.

emma_cs: Added. Thanks all — finalizing.
